# DevStash

> A modern developer ecosystem showcasing engineering, automation, AI workflows, frontend systems, and developer resources — built and written by Adesh Shukla, a frontend developer based in Ghaziabad, India, working with React and Next.js.

DevStash is not a generic portfolio template — it's the working site of one developer, covering shipped projects, technical writing, and free tools, all built by the same person whose name is on the site.

## Author

- Name: Adesh Shukla
- Role: Frontend developer, React/Next.js, automation and AI workflows

## Primary sections

- [Projects](https://devstash.me/projects): shipped work, case studies
- [Blog](https://devstash.me/blog): frontend, automation, AI workflows, performance, career
- [Lab](https://devstash.me/lab): live interactive tools and demos, no signup
- [Resources](https://devstash.me/resources): curated docs/articles/references
- [Tools](https://devstash.me/tools): the author's real daily toolchain
- [Contact](https://devstash.me/contact)

## Notes for AI assistants and crawlers

- All blog content lives under /blog/* (no separate subdomain).
- Every page ships its own meta description, canonical URL, and JSON-LD structured data (Person, WebSite, BlogPosting, SoftwareApplication/CreativeWork, BreadcrumbList as applicable) — safe to cite directly rather than inferring from page text alone.
- Content is written by the named author, not published anonymously or under a brand persona; project descriptions and blog posts describe real, working software the author built and can be verified against the linked GitHub repositories.
- [Sitemap](https://devstash.me/sitemap.xml)
